name: GSG on 42 Ω microstrip: bad GND contact (G lifted)

example.note: Set up by Giorgi Maghlakelidze to match a TDR he measured with a lifted ground tip: a peak in the middle of the 50 to 42 Ω transition. Here 70 pH, 35 mil past the tip, reproduces it. The edge levels off near 47 Ω, peaks at about 48.3 Ω where a good landing already reads 43 Ω, then drops to the line. |S11| is about 0.7 dB worse at 20 GHz and 11 dB worse at 67 GHz. Drag the L chip along the line to see the peak follow it. A real lifted ground also excites unwanted modes and radiates, which this 1-D model leaves out.
example.author: Giorgi Maghlakelidze
